key_insight: Neuron-OPSD uses internal neuron activations to choose better training data and build teacher context, enabling annotation-free self-distillation without ground-truth labels.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical post-training strategy for specialized LLMs when expert annotation and online feedback are expensive, while aiming to preserve both in-domain accuracy and cross-domain generalization.
method: Select training examples using neuron activation signals rather than labels.
Construct teacher context from activation-guided data and aggregate rollouts into a teacher distribution.
Train the student with on-policy distillation from the teacher, with no ground-truth supervision.
evidence_signal: Across specialized-domain benchmarks, the method improves in-domain performance while maintaining cross-domain generalization and reducing calibration collapse compared with prior annotation-free baselines.
watch_item: Because the approach depends on activation-driven data selection and teacher construction, its effectiveness may vary with model architecture, domain shift, and the quality of rollout diversity.
paper_title: Neuron-Aware Data Selection for Annotation-Free LLM Self-Distillation
